transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what brings you here today?

Um… I guess it’s mostly my sleep. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but it’s gotten pretty bad. I work overnights, and when I get off I’ll be so tired, but then I just lay there wide awake. And when I finally do fall asleep, I wake up scared, like I didn’t really rest at all. I just… wasn’t sure if that’s something I should come in for, but it’s been hard.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried around the time you’re trying to fall asleep?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t know if I’d call it anxiety exactly, but when I’m trying to sleep after an overnight, I’m just lying there wide awake even though I’m exhausted. And then if I do drift off, I wake up scared, like I didn’t really rest. It’s probably not the worst thing, but it’s been happening enough that I thought I should ask about it.
How often do you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep, even when you feel tired?

Most days after my overnight shifts, I think. I’ll be really tired, so I feel like I should just fall asleep, but I end up lying there awake for a long time. And then when I finally do sleep, it’s kind of broken up… I wake up scared and like I didn’t really rest. I don’t know if that answers it right, but it’s been happening a lot.
Outside of trying to sleep, do you find yourself feeling anxious or on edge during the day?

Um… during the day, I’m not really sure. I mean, I don’t think I walk around feeling panicky or anything like that. Maybe I get a little tense sometimes, but I kind of figure that’s normal with work and being tired. I’m not sure if that’s what you mean.
Have you ever experienced sudden episodes of intense fear or panic, especially during the night, where you wake up feeling extremely frightened or like something bad is happening?

I don’t know if it’s like a full panic thing, but… yeah, at night, or when I’m trying to sleep after an overnight shift, I’ll finally drift off and then wake up really scared, like something’s wrong. I come in mostly because my sleep is just all broken up now. Even when I’m exhausted, I lie there wide awake, and then if I do sleep, it feels like I didn’t rest at all. Is that what you mean?

When you wake up feeling scared during the night, do you notice your heart racing, sweating, or feeling like you can’t breathe, or is it more of a general sense of fear without those physical symptoms?

I don’t know that I notice all the body stuff every time… like I’m not sure about sweating or not breathing. It’s more that I wake up scared, and then I feel like I never really rested. It’s just my sleep is all broken up now—after an overnight shift I can be exhausted and still lie there wide awake, and then if I do drift off, I wake up scared. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?
When you wake up feeling scared during the night, does your heart race, do you sweat, or do you feel like you can’t catch your breath?

I’m honestly not sure. I don’t really notice my heart or sweating like that… at least not enough to say for sure. It’s more like I wake up scared and confused for a minute. I’m sorry, I know that’s probably not a clear answer.
When you wake up feeling scared at night, do you ever feel like your heart is pounding, you're sweating, or you're suddenly very short of breath?

I don’t think so… not that I’ve really noticed. I mean, I wake up scared, but I’m not sitting there thinking my heart is pounding or that I can’t breathe. Maybe I’m just not paying attention to it. Sorry, is that okay to say?
During the day, have you ever had sudden episodes where you feel intense fear or discomfort that comes out of nowhere, even when there's no clear reason for it?

I don’t think I’ve had it like that during the day… like, out of nowhere intense fear. I get uneasy sometimes, but I don’t know if that’s what you mean. It’s not really like a sudden attack or anything, at least not that I’ve noticed. Is that the kind of answer you’re looking for?
During the day, have you ever experienced sudden episodes of fear or discomfort that included physical symptoms like a pounding heart, sweating, or shortness of breath?

Not really, no… I mean, I don’t think I’ve had the pounding heart or sweating or not breathing during the day like that. I get uncomfortable sometimes, but not like a sudden physical episode. I hope that makes sense.
Do you often wake up feeling as though you haven’t rested at all, even after you’ve been asleep for a while?

Yeah… I do, pretty often. I mean, I can get off an overnight shift and I’m exhausted, but then I’ll just lay there awake for a long time. And even when I finally do fall asleep, I wake up scared and it feels like I didn’t really sleep, like my body never rested. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but… yeah, that’s been happening.
Do you ever wake up in the morning feeling as tired as when you went to bed, even if you managed to sleep for a few hours?

Yeah… I think so. Even if I get a few hours, it doesn’t really feel like sleep helped. I’ll get off my overnight shift and still be lying there wide awake, and then when I finally drift off, I wake up scared and just… still tired, like I didn’t rest at all. I hope I’m explaining that right.
Even on the nights when you do manage to sleep for a few hours without waking up much, do you still wake up feeling as though you haven’t rested at all?

Yeah… even when I don’t wake up a lot, I still don’t feel rested. It’s like I’ll get off my overnight shift and be so tired, but then I just lie there wide awake for a long time. And if I do sleep a few hours, I wake up feeling scared and like my body never really got any rest. I don’t know if that’s the right way to explain it.
Even on the nights when you sleep for a few hours without waking up much, do you still wake up feeling as though you haven’t rested at all?

Yeah… I’m sorry, I know I kind of said this already, but yes. Even if I sleep a few hours and don’t wake up a bunch, I still wake up feeling like I didn’t really rest. I get off my overnight shift exhausted, and then I’ll be lying there wide awake, and when I finally do drift off I wake up scared… like my body never really settled. Does that make sense?

Yes… I think that’s what’s been happening. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but my sleep feels all broken up now. I get off my overnight shift and I’m exhausted, but then I’ll just lie there awake, and when I finally do drift off, I wake up scared and like I didn’t really rest at all. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?

Yeah… yes, that’s right. I know I’ve said it a few times, sorry. It’s just… I get off my overnight shift and I’m so tired, but then I’ll still lie there wide awake. And even if I do drift off for a little while, I wake up scared and it feels like I never really rested at all.
Even when you have a full opportunity to sleep, like on days off when you don’t have to work, do you still wake up feeling as though you haven’t rested at all?

Yeah… even when I don’t have to work, it’s kind of the same. I mean, I’ll have the chance to sleep, and I’m tired, but I still end up lying there awake. Then if I do fall asleep, I wake up scared and like… like it didn’t really count as rest. I’m sorry if I’m repeating myself, but yes, that’s been happening.
Even when you have a consistent sleep schedule and no external stressors like work, do you still wake up feeling as though you haven’t rested at all?

I mean… I don’t really know if I’ve had a truly steady schedule lately, because of the overnight shifts. But even when I do get the chance to sleep, it’s like my body won’t let me. I’ll be exhausted and still lie there awake, and then if I finally drift off, I wake up scared and feel like I didn’t actually rest. I hope that answers what you’re asking.
Even when you have a full night’s sleep and aren’t disturbed, do you still wake up feeling like you haven’t rested at all?

I don’t know if I’d call it a full night exactly… but yes, even when nobody’s waking me up, it still feels that way. I’ll be so tired after my overnight shift and then just lie there awake, and if I do finally drift off, I wake up scared and like I didn’t really rest. I’m sorry, I know I keep saying it weird, but that’s what it feels like.
Even when you have a full and uninterrupted sleep, do you still wake up feeling like you haven’t rested at all, no matter how long you slept?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to exaggerate, but that’s kind of why I came in. And when I finally do drift off, I wake up scared and it feels like I didn’t really rest at all. Is that… is that what you mean?
